newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends lower and below key level.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends lower and below key level.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled a thinly traded session lower as a dearth of fundamental news and upcoming industry events kept the market within a tight range, traders said.
The July contract closed 0.04 cent weaker at 10.97 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.05 to 10.95. The outer contracts closed 0.01 lower to 0.04 higher.
An estimated 8,668 lots changed hands against Thursday's official 7,248 lots.

Technically, a close below key 11.00 cents does not bode well for higher prices next week. But with many players in New York for the annual U.S. Cane Sugar Refiners' Association dinner on Wednesday, activity could remain rangebound and thin, industry sources said.
Support was pegged at 10.92 and then 10.85 cents for July sugar, with resistance at 11.11 and then 11.20 cents.
